General:

Vietnamese visa is a kind of travel documents granted by Vietnamese competent authorities, providing permission to travel to and enter Vietnam.

An electronic visa (E-visa) is one of visa types issued to foreigners by Vietnamese Immigration Department via electronic system. Vietnam E-visa is valid for maximum of 90 days, single or multiple entry.
Outside Vietnam foreigners who want to enter Vietnam can personally apply for E-visa or through the requesting agencies and organizations.

E-visa fee is paid via electronic payment gateway as prescribed by the Immigration Department. The fee will not be refunded if the application is refused.

List of Ports that allowed foreigners enter and exit Vietnam by E-visa.

Conditions for being granted e-visa:
  * Outside Vietnam foreigners;
  * Holding valid passport;
  * Not falling into the cases of suspension from entry prescribed in Article 21 of Law on foreigners' entry into, exit from, transit through, residence in Vietnam.

## VGP – Since August 15, 2023, all foreigners can apply for e-visa to visit Viet Nam regardless of their nationality.

Hai Minh

November 11, 2024 12:57 PM GMT+7

Image: How to apply for e-visa to enter Viet Nam- Ảnh 1. 
All necessary information on e-visa is already available on e-visa website https://evisa.gov.vn/ managed by the Immigration Department under the Ministry of Public Security.
  * #### Pakistan offers free e-visa to Vietnamese tourists, businessmen 
  * #### INFOGRAPHIC: VIET NAM TO RENEW E-VISA DURATION TO 90 DAYS 
The website provides general information on Viet Nam's e-visa policy, instructions for e-visa application, list of border gates designed by the Government for entry and exit with e-visa, and frequently asked questions.

E-visa issued by Viet Nam shall be valid for maximum of 90 days, single or multiple entry.
Foreigners who are citizens of countries that are unilaterally exempted from visas by Viet Nam when entering Viet Nam will be granted a 45-day temporary residence certificate.
